messages:
maria: FYI kestrel-14b (q4f16) default rollout hit prod at 02:00 UTC. We're getting a few customer tickets reporting repeated tokens mid-gen + higher p99 latency. Anyone seeing this in metrics? :eyes:
ajay: I see a spike starting ~02:05 UTC. p50 stable, p99 up ~120ms. Also a small bump in token-repetition score on our eval hooks. Not huge but noticeable.
devops-bot: Deploy complete: kestrel-14b q4f16 -> route=stable instances=48 region=us-west-2 commit=sha@c1d2e3f status=ok
linh: Can you paste a failing example? repetition or full-loop stall?
maria: Short example from a support case: "The cat sat on the the the the" repeated 4x after mid-length prompt. I'll paste full prompt privately.
ajay: Pulling logs from the batcher. There's an attention kernel fallback warning interleaved with quantize warnings:```2026-02-14T02:06:11Z WARN kernel_selector: fallback to reference_attn for layer 22 model=kestrel-14b device=gpu-0
2026-02-14T02:06:11Z WARN quantize: encountered unsupported fp16 op: gelu_fast, forcing slow-path
2026-02-14T02:06:12Z INFO kvcache: dropped prefix cache for seq_len>2048```
sam: Hmm fallback + kvcache drop could explain repetition if KV state resets mid-stream. Any recent kernel update in runtime?
tony: Runtime had a small change yesterday that tightened workspace allocation. Might cause kernel_selector to prefer fallback when memory estimate near threshold. Patch id: runtime@b5f4.
linh: Also noticed tokenizer detected unknown tokens for some punctuation sequences with this model's pretokenization. Could be off-by-one split causing duplicate tokens.
rachel: From eval harness: reproduction rate for repetition (>=3 repeats) jumped from 0.8% -> 3.9% under q4f16 quant. FP16 baseline at same throughput is 0.9%. So quant looks correlated.
maria: OK action plan proposals: 1) rollback stable route to fp16 variant, 2) revert runtime workspace patch on canary, 3) run targeted prompt set through q4f16 locally to repro and get trace. Thoughts?
ajay: Do 1 and 3 immediately. Rollback reduces customer impact. I'll stage a canary revert for 2 but that's higher risk.
sam: I'll attach a small repro harness:```# repro script
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"model":"kestrel-14b-q4f16","prompt":"The cat sat on the"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN'```
linh: Quick check: tokenizer config for kestrel-14b shows "add_prefix_space": false while our canon expect true for this model family. That explains punctuation/newline splits. I'll make a tokenization-only test against fp16 and q4f16.
ton y: (typo) sorry meant tony: I'm on rollback to kestrel-14b-fp16 on stable. Starting now.
devops-bot: Route update: kestrel-14b-fp16 -> stable (instances=48) change_in_progress
ajay: Running the prompt set locally against q4f16 with kv-trace enabled. If kvcache reset is happening we'll capture layer where mismatch occurs.
maria: Created ticket INF-2971 with logs + evaluation diffs. Assigning to @ajay and @linh. Please add findings and ETA.
rachel: After rollback p99 latency back to normal within 2 mins and support ticketer confirmed fewer repeats in sample tests. We'll keep q4f16 in canary paused.
linh: Initial tokenizer test shows q4f16 and fp16 token streams differ in punctuation handling 2/50 prompts. That's probably separate but worth fixing.
ajay: KV trace shows a cache eviction triggered by memory estimate mismatch at layer 21 for one long prompt; following token stream shows repeated tokens immediately after. Repro steps attached in INF-2971.
maria: Good work. Short term: keep fp16 on stable, q4f16 paused. Medium: quantify how many customers affected, improve kernel selector heuristics, and land tokenizer patch.
sam: I'll open a perf test to exercise workspace limits and run longer prefixes to see where fallback triggers.
frank: (not in participants) sorry wrong channel
maria: Thanks all. We'll post a short announcement to #incidents with mitigations and a follow-up postmortem scheduled tomorrow 10:00 UTC. :white_check_mark:
